mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, which significantly increases the metabolism and clearance of risperidone, reducing its plasma concentrations and antipsychotic efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and consider increasing risperidone dose or selecting an alternative antipsychotic not dependent on these CYP450 enzymes; therapeutic drug monitoring is recommended.
